ux.cloud.terms.siteIntro: You need to agree to the terms once. Agree on murage.ai, then come back here.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.title: One more step.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.body: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it to {act}.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.resendWait: You can ask for another code in {seconds} seconds.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.wrong: That code didn't work. Try again.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.expired: That code has expired. We can send a new one.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.locked: Too many tries on that code. Send a new code.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.tooMany: That's a lot of codes for one day. Try again tomorrow.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.couldNotSend: We couldn't send your code just now. Nothing was changed. Try again in a minute.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.unavailable: Nothing was changed. Try again in a minute.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.changed: This request changed. Review it again before you allow it.
ux.cloud.ownerCode.act.computer_viewer: open a view of the bot's screen
ux.cloud.ownerCode.act.bot_widen: allow more than this setting allowed before
ux.cloud.ownerCode.act.publish_allow: allow this site to be published
ux.cloud.ownerBanner.expired: To change settings, open Murage from murage.ai.
ux.cloud.signin.leadLink: Sign in to {engine}. A new tab opens. Come back here when it says you're done.
ux.cloud.signin.leadCode: Sign in to {engine}. Click the link below, approve in the new tab, then paste the code it shows into the box here.
ux.cloud.signin.notHere: You can't sign in to {engine} from a browser yet. Use the Murage desktop app for it.
ux.cloud.firstRun.hello: Hello, I'm Ember. What should I call you?
ux.cloud.firstRun.stepFailed: That did not go through. Try once more.
ux.cloud.firstRun.job.brief.title: Brief me every morning
ux.cloud.firstRun.job.brief.sub: Each morning, I give you one short page of what needs your attention first. I use your calendar and email once you connect them.
ux.cloud.firstRun.job.day.title: Plan my day
ux.cloud.firstRun.job.day.sub: Type in today's tasks, one per line. I tell you which task will run late and what to do first.
ux.cloud.firstRun.job.notes.title: Tidy up my notes
ux.cloud.firstRun.job.notes.sub: Paste in your notes. I pick out the next steps and put those with a date or someone waiting for them first.
ux.cloud.firstRun.job.research.title: Look into something for me
ux.cloud.firstRun.job.research.sub: Like which dishwasher to buy. I read around and tell you what I found and what I am not sure of.
ux.cloud.firstRun.job.business.title: Help me run my business
ux.cloud.firstRun.job.business.sub: I set up two helpers, one to choose your top task and one to prepare a draft for it, plus a weekly review you switch on when you like.
ux.cloud.firstRun.bookmark: Bookmark this page so you can come back.
ux.cloud.firstRun.bookmarkDoor: Bookmark this page so you can come back. You can always return at {site}/home/cloud.
ux.cloud.firstRun.unreachable: Can't reach your Murage right now. Anything you type is kept, and this reconnects by itself.
